description: Places in the plugin code and the bundled engine that match a pattern of tests/helpers/networkPatterns.ts, with the reason why they make no network request (design 12, 16). A new match, or a different count, fails tests/network.test.ts and must be checked again.

createElement.reason: The save-as-image feature of the toolbox (an iframe for old Internet Explorer). The input guard removes every toolbox option (inputGuard.ts), and the chart is a static SVG without the toolbox.

newImage.reason: zrender's loadImage(), used for image patterns and image symbols while the SVG is built. The input guard removes every 'image' key and every 'image://' string first (inputGuard.ts, design 12), so no URL reaches it.

newFunction.reason: Fallback parser of GeoJSON for maps, used only when JSON.parse is missing. Maps are refused by the input guard (inputGuard.ts) before the engine runs.
